processExitProbe.interpretation: Only redirected Start-Process without retained native Handle loses ExitCode after WaitForExit; retaining Handle before waiting preserves exit7. Both redirected fixture sites now retain Handle. The maintained failure phase asserts exact exit1.

preflight: Every run checked all seven current source SHA-256 values against native Get-FileHash and parsed the two PowerShell fixtures before launching. Signed-in Session1 verified. Original deadline35 seconds preserved.
timingEvidence: Invocation metadata uses control-host UTC; native progress log uses VM UTC. Clock offsets are not used as causal evidence.

originalFailure.observation: No terminal receipt before deadline. Original child logs were deleted by the old wrapper, so originating cause is unconfirmed. Current source passes40; no claim that this proves the cause of the earlier timeout.

localNode.scope: packaging assertion only; skipped tests are not native proof
